!comment: whisper.cpp, which recognizes speech on the device (3rdparty/whisper/CMakeLists.txt): one release, only its whisper library compiled from its sources, over llama.cpp's ggml (3rdparty/llama) — never its own ggml copy. `hash` is Nix's (fetchFromGitHub: nix/package.nix, nix/android.nix, the dev shell), `sha256` the release archive's (scripts that download it: scripts/llama-source.sh --whisper). Its ggml must keep llama.cpp's interface: whisper.cpp 1.9.5 bundles ggml 0.26.0, llama.cpp v0.9.0 has 0.29.0, and whisper.cpp uses only ggml's backend registry (no call into the processor plugins).
